Sam: FYI 10A pricebook canary plan ready. Need quick sign-offs on preservation rules and reconciliation checks. Canary: 5% new pricing, ramp 25% in 48h, 50% in 48h, then cutover if OK.
Arjun: Reminder  do not change recurring invoice amounts mid-cycle for active subs. We need a clear preserve tag.
Mei: Billing will write a preserve_flag and skip price lookup for preserved subs. Also will add canonical_sku column for mapping.
Rob: Engineering will expose feature flag and deterministic cohort assigner (subscription_id hash) and persist cohort tag. Flag example:
```
price_migration: { cohorts: [{p:5},{p:25},{p:50}], preserve_window_days:30, vendor_surge_threshold_pct:6 }
```
Nikhil (VendorOps): Vendor pass-through shows +2.8% this week. Will emit alert to migration dashboard if >4%.
Eve: Legal needs a refunds clause in comms. Also marketing will prepare renewal banner/email.
BillingBot: Dry run scheduled: id=inv-dry-223456; dataset=staging_meters_2026-03; output=/shared/finance/migrations/inv-dry-223456.csv; eta=20m.
Sam: Targeting toggle 07:00 UTC tomorrow. Finance sign-off contingent on dry run: invoice_count_delta <0.5% and net_billing_delta <0.2%.
Arjun: I can approve if those hold and ledger keys remain stable.
Mei: Will post dry-run diff + margin delta when done.
Sam: Thanks all, please ack in-thread by EOD to proceed.
